versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אֹ֜רֶךְ וְחָמֵ֧שׁ אַמּ֣וֹת רֹ֗חַב רָב֤וּעַ יִהְיֶה֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be square: and its height shall be three cubits.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
controles.livre: Farás também altar de madeira de acácia de cinco côvados de comprimento, e de cinco côvados de largura: será quadrado o altar, e sua altura de três côvados.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ קַרְנֹתָ֗יו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔יו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ תִּהְיֶ֣יןָ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: You shall make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be of one piece with it; and you shall overlay it with brass.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
controles.livre: E farás suas pontas a seus quatro cantos; as pontas serão do mesmo; e as cobrirás de bronze.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ סִּֽירֹתָיו֙ לְדַשְּׁנ֔וֹ וְיָעָיו֙ וּמִזְרְקֹתָ֔יו וּמִזְלְגֹתָ֖יו וּמַחְתֹּתָ֑יו לְכָל־כֵּלָ֖יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes, its shovels, its basins, its flesh hooks, and its fire pans: all its vessels you shall make of brass.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
controles.livre: Farás também seus caldeirões para lançar sua cinza; e suas pás, e suas bacias, e seus garfos, e seus braseiros: farás todos os seus vasos de bronze.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ לּוֹ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל־הָרֶ֗שֶׁת אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥ע קְצוֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: You shall make a grating for it of network of brass: and on the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
controles.livre: E lhe farás uma grelha de bronze de obra de malha; e sobre a grelha farás quatro anéis de bronze a seus quatro cantos.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ תַּ֛חַת כַּרְכֹּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ מִלְּמָ֑טָּה וְהָיְתָ֣ה הָרֶ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ד חֲצִ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
controles.livre: E o porás dentro da borda do altar abaixo; e chegará a grelha até o meio do altar.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ בַדִּים֙ לַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with brass.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
controles.livre: Farás também varas para o altar, varas de madeira de acácia, as quais cobrirás de bronze.

versos.hebraico: וְהוּבָ֥א אֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו בַּטַּבָּעֹ֑ת וְהָי֣וּ הַבַּדִּ֗ים עַל־שְׁתֵּ֛י צַלְעֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בִּשְׂאֵ֥ת אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar, when carrying it.
controles.kjv: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
controles.livre: E suas varas se meterão pelos anéis: e estarão aquelas varas a ambos lados do altar, quando houver de ser levado.

versos.hebraico: נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֥ה אֹתְךָ֛ בָּהָ֖ר כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס

controles.web: You shall make it with hollow planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
controles.kjv: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
controles.livre: De tábuas o farás, oco: da maneira que te foi mostrado no monte, assim o farás.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֖ת חֲצַ֣ר הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן לִפְאַ֣ת נֶֽגֶב־תֵּ֠ימָנָה קְלָעִ֨ים לֶחָצֵ֜ר שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר מֵאָ֤ה בָֽאַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ לַפֵּאָ֖ה הָאֶחָֽת׃

controles.web: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side:
controles.kjv: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
controles.livre: Também farás o átrio do tabernáculo: ao lado do sul, terá o átrio cortinas de linho torcido, de cem côvados de comprimento cada um lado;

versos.hebraico: וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

controles.web: and its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
controles.kjv: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
controles.livre: Suas vinte colunas, e suas vinte bases serão de bronze; os capitéis das colunas e suas molduras, de prata.

versos.hebraico: וְכֵ֨ן לִפְאַ֤ת צָפוֹן֙ בָּאֹ֔רֶךְ קְלָעִ֖ים מֵ֣אָה אֹ֑רֶךְ ועמדו עֶשְׂרִ֗ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֤ם עֶשְׂרִים֙ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָֽעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

controles.web: Likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
controles.kjv: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
controles.livre: E da mesma maneira ao lado do norte haverá ao comprimento cortinas de cem côvados de comprimento, e suas vinte colunas, com suas vinte bases de bronze; os capitéis de suas colunas e suas molduras, de prata.

versos.hebraico: וְרֹ֤חַב הֶֽחָצֵר֙ לִפְאַת־יָ֔ם קְלָעִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֲשָׂרָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃

controles.web: For the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
controles.kjv: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
controles.livre: E a largura do átrio do lado ocidental terá cortinas de cinquenta côvados; suas colunas dez, com suas dez bases.

versos.hebraico: וְרֹ֣חַב הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר לִפְאַ֛ת קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָ֖חָה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: The breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
controles.kjv: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
controles.livre: E na largura do átrio pela parte do oriente, haverá cinquenta côvados.

versos.hebraico: וַחֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֛ה קְלָעִ֖ים לַכָּתֵ֑ף עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
controles.kjv: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
controles.livre: E as cortinas de um lado serão de quinze côvados; suas colunas três, com suas três bases.

versos.hebraico: וְלַכָּתֵף֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית חְמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה קְלָעִ֑ים עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

controles.web: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
controles.kjv: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
controles.livre: Ao outro lado quinze côvados de cortinas; suas colunas três, com suas três bases.

versos.hebraico: וּלְשַׁ֨עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר מָסָ֣ךְ׀ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְתוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם עַמֻּֽדֵיהֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַרְבָּעָֽה׃

controles.web: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
controles.kjv: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
controles.livre: E à porta do átrio haverá uma cortina de vinte côvados, de azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho torcido, de obra de bordador: suas colunas quatro, com suas quatro bases.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־עַמּוּדֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֤ר סָבִיב֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף וָוֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of brass.
controles.kjv: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
controles.livre: Todas as colunas do átrio em derredor serão cingidas de prata; seus capitéis de prata, e suas bases de bronze.

versos.hebraico: אֹ֣רֶךְ הֶֽחָצֵר֩ מֵאָ֨ה בָֽאַמָּ֜ה וְרֹ֣חַב׀ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים וְקֹמָ֛ה חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
controles.kjv: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
controles.livre: O comprimento do átrio será de cem côvados, e a largura cinquenta por um lado e cinquenta pelo outro, e a altura de cinco côvados: suas cortinas de linho torcido, e suas bases de bronze.

versos.hebraico: לְכֹל֙ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן בְּכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָת֑וֹ וְכָל־יְתֵדֹתָ֛יו וְכָל־יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ס

controles.web: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
controles.kjv: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
controles.livre: Todos os utensílios do tabernáculo em todo o seu serviço, e todos os seus pregos, e todos os pregos do átrio, serão de bronze.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֞ה תְּצַוֶּ֣ה׀ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃

controles.web: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
controles.livre: E tu mandarás aos filhos de Israel que te tragam azeite puro de olivas, prensado, para a luminária, para fazer arder continuamente as lâmpadas.

versos.hebraico: בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֩ מִח֨וּץ לַפָּרֹ֜כֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָעֵדֻ֗ת יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו מֵעֶ֥רֶב עַד־בֹּ֖קֶר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹ֣רֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the Lord: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: No tabernáculo do testemunho, fora do véu que está diante do testemunho, as porá em ordem Arão e seus filhos, diante do SENHOR desde a tarde até a manhã, como estatuto perpétuo dos filhos de Israel por suas gerações.
